papers.title_en: Meta Expert: Cross-Layer Expert Sharing for Storage- and Retrieval-Efficient MoE
papers.authors: Ermo Hua, Xiangyu Hong, Baiting Wu, Che Jiang, Haozheng Hou, Yicheng Gu, Hanjing Wang, Qirui Zeng, Ming Zhang, Ning Ding, Qipeng Guo, Youbang Sun, Biqing Qi, Bowen Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向存储高效MoE的跨层专家共享
papers.tldr: 随着参数规模扩大，稀疏激活MoE成为扩展关键，但分层架构中不同层专家存在显著内容相似与冗余。论文提出层间共享的Meta Expert，替代主流分层Local Expert，并通过多维实证与理论分析验证其优势。在激活数量和专家粒度固定时，该模型仅用70—80%的专家即可匹配Vanilla MoE性能，同时降低参数冗余和交叉熵、提升下游准确率。其贡献在于减少层间冗余、提高存储与检索效率，并增强模型扩展潜力。
papers.abstract_en: As model parameters scale up, sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches have become essential for model scaling. However, mainstream models currently adopt hierarchical architectures, where experts in different layers, although topologically independent, exhibit substantial similarity and redundancy in their stored content. Compared to the hierarchically arranged \textbf{Local Expert} in existing mainstream models, we hypothesize that inter-layer shared \textbf{Meta Expert} hold greater potential. To this end, we conduct a multi-dimensional empirical comparison between Local and Meta Experts, and find that models incorporating Meta Experts exhibit lower parameter redundancy, together with lower cross-entropy loss and higher downstream task accuracy. With the activated quantity and the expert granularity held fixed, \textbf{our model matches the performance of Vanilla MoE using only 70--80\% of the experts}, substantially improving the model's scaling potential. Beyond removing inter-layer redundancy among experts and improving information storage efficiency, our theoretical analysis further shows that, compared with Local Experts, Meta Experts provide hidden states with more flexible residual pathways, thereby improving information retrieval efficiency.

papers.title_en: Pipelining vs. Combining in Aggregation Tasks
papers.authors: Gabriel Marques Domingues, Claire Mathieu, Boaz Patt-Shamir
papers.evidence: 研究聚合与汇聚通信中的流水线和合并策略
papers.tldr: 针对聚合值大于单条消息容量的网络convergecast问题，论文比较流水线传输与合并聚合两种策略。作者建模值以消息列车流水线传输、聚合前需终止列车，并给出一般下界。随后在可分裂与不可分裂流模型下，为超立方体和完全二部图等并行架构设计最优算法，并为一般不可分裂流图给出O(log n)近似。该工作统一刻画流水线与合并的权衡，为大数据聚合提供理论保证。
papers.abstract_en: We study the aggregation task (convergecast) in networks in the case that the values to be aggregated do not fit in a single message. We assume that every node starts with an input value, and there is an aggregation operator that is commutative, associative, and length-preserving, i.e., the result of aggregating two values has the same length as each of the input values. Since values do not fit in a message, they are transferred in a ``train'' of pipelined messages, which must be terminated whenever we want to aggregate values. The goal is to minimize the makespan time of aggregating all values. We present general lower bounds on the problem and optimal algorithms for several prevalent parallel computing architectures, including the hypercube and complete bipartite graphs, under both the splittable and unsplittable flows models. We also present an $O(\log n)$ approximation for general graphs in the unsplittable flows model.
